# Cinnabelle — G4 background unicorn

Cinnabelle is a light-blue unicorn mare with a pink mane and tail and dark blue-violet eyes. She's a background face from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*: first spotted in Granny Smith's sepia-toned recollection of early Ponyville, then recognizable in full color at a Grand Galloping Gala. No secret identity or alter ego is documented.

[![Cinnabelle, a unicorn at the Grand Galloping Gala (show still)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/f/f3/Cinnabelle_ID_S5E7.png/revision/latest?cb=20150519202944)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies)

*Image: screen capture from the Hasbro Studios/DHX Media television production, indexed on the MLP Friendship is Magic Wiki; no individual animator is verified.*

**Name and identity.** “Cinnabelle” is an **unofficial fandom/wiki placeholder**, not a verified spoken, credited, or merchandise name. The name was in use by a [2013 fan-wiki comparison discussion](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Forum:PonyComparison/Archive_4), which treated her as distinct from the similar-looking *Dosie Dough* (an Earth pony). The linked unicorn character index also notes a resemblance to *Apple Twirl*; neither resemblance establishes a shared identity. Her cutie mark is not reliably identified.

**Voice and appearances.** No verified dialogue or individual voice actor. Identified on screen in *Family Appreciation Day* (S2E12), *Make New Friends but Keep Discord* (S5E7), and a brief flashback in [*No Second Prances* (S6E6)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165232/s06-e06-no-second-prances). A [comic character index](https://comicvine.gamespot.com/my-little-pony-pageants-and-ponies-1-gn/4000-498417/) also lists her in *Pageants and Ponies* (2015), an adaptation of television episodes—not a verified independent storyline.

## Important moments

Cinnabelle has no verified character-driven dialogue, decisions, or plot-changing scenes. These are her two most useful *identification* moments, not starring roles:

- **An early Ponyville memory — “Family Appreciation Day” (S2E12).** She is visible in Granny Smith's sepia recollection while Granny explains Ponyville's beginnings. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vaSivR8A2x4) · scene timestamp unavailable.
- **A full-color return — “Make New Friends but Keep Discord” (S5E7).** She appears among the Grand Galloping Gala guests, making her blue-and-pink appearance easier to recognize. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FWqiJJ3ied4) · scene timestamp unavailable.
